project_type: React Native (Expo) mobile app + Node.js/Express/MongoDB REST API monorepo
language: JavaScript (ESM on server with `"type": "module"`, JSX on mobile)
build_system: Server: plain Node.js ESM, no bundler. Mobile: Expo managed workflow (npx expo export). npm workspaces NOT used — server and mobile have separate package.json files.
test_framework: No automated test suite exists. Verification is: server syntax check via `node --check`, server start smoke test via `node src/server.js`, mobile bundle via `npx expo export --platform android`.
build_command: Server: `cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\server && node src/server.js`. Mobile: `cd c:\Users\Dell\Desktop\PROWASH\mobile && npx expo export --platform android`.
test_command: Server syntax: `node --check <file>`. Server start: `node src/server.js` (must see 'MongoDB connected'). Mobile bundle: `npx expo export --platform android` (exit 0).
verification_instructions: 1. For every modified server file run `node --check <file>` to catch syntax errors. 2. Start server with `cd server && node src/server.js` and confirm it binds the port without crashing. 3. Curl key endpoints to confirm routes exist (see phase5-plan.md step 15). 4. Bundle mobile with `cd mobile && npx expo export --platform android` and confirm exit 0.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell — use `;` not `&&` to chain commands. Server uses ESM (`type: module`) — all imports must use `.js` extensions. `razorpay` npm package is not yet installed; FEAT-001 must run `npm install` in server/. react-native-razorpay is deliberately NOT installed — PaymentScreen must never import it.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md found. Inferred from codebase: follow existing ESM import style, use AppError for server errors, use existing component/service patterns in mobile, do not introduce new dependencies beyond razorpay on server.
key_patterns: Server: async/await + try/catch + next(err) in every controller. AppError(message, statusCode) for user-facing errors. Fire-and-forget notifications with .catch(console.error). Models use Mongoose with explicit required validators. Mobile: `import api from './api'` for HTTP calls (axios instance). Screens use LoadingView/ErrorView/EmptyState components. Navigation uses React Navigation v6 native stack + bottom tabs. Colors/typography imported from ../../theme/. useFocusEffect for data reload on screen focus.
directory_structure: PROWASH/ — workspace root. server/ — Express API (src/controllers/, src/routes/, src/models/, src/services/, src/middleware/). mobile/ — Expo RN app (src/screens/customer/, src/services/, src/navigation/, src/components/, src/theme/). .agents/tasks/ — plan and FEAT artifacts (never committed).
